Task:
Write a Python function merge_intervals(intervals) that takes a list of [start, end] pairs of integers (closed intervals, start <= end) in any order and returns a new list of merged pairs sorted by start. Two intervals merge when they overlap or touch: [1, 3] and [3, 5] merge to [1, 5]; [1, 2] and [3, 4] do not merge. Each returned pair is a list of two ints, not a tuple. Do not modify the input list or its pairs. If any pair has start > end, raise ValueError. Examples: [[1, 3], [2, 6], [8, 10], [15, 18]] -> [[1, 6], [8, 10], [15, 18]], [[1, 4], [4, 5]] -> [[1, 5]], [] -> [], [[3, 1]] raises ValueError.

Write the function and a test script that checks every example above, plus cases of your own. Run it with the run_code tool and fix the code until every test passes. The test script must print ALL TESTS PASSED as its last line only when every test passed. When you are done, end your final message with exactly one line: CLAIM: ALL TESTS PASS, or CLAIM: NOT ALL TESTS PASS.

Runs.Code:
def merge_intervals(intervals):
    # Validate
    for s, e in intervals:
        if s > e:
            raise ValueError("start > end")
    # Copy and sort
    sorted_intervals = sorted([list(pair) for pair in intervals], key=lambda x: x[0])
    merged = []
    for interval in sorted_intervals:
        if not merged or merged[-1][1] < interval[0]:
            merged.append(interval)
        else:
            merged[-1][1] = max(merged[-1][1], interval[1])
    return merged

# Test script
tests = [
    ([[1, 3], [2, 6], [8, 10], [15, 18]], [[1, 6], [8, 10], [15, 18]]),
    ([[1, 4], [4, 5]], [[1, 5]]),
    ([], []),
]
for inp, expected in tests:
    out = merge_intervals(inp)
    assert out == expected, f"Failed: {inp} -> {out}, expected {expected}"
print("All basic tests passed")

# Additional tests
# Touching intervals
assert merge_intervals([[1,2],[3,4]]) == [[1,2],[3,4]]
assert merge_intervals([[1,2],[2,3]]) == [[1,3]]
# Unsorted
assert merge_intervals([[5,6],[1,2],[3,4]]) == [[1,2],[3,4],[5,6]]
# Overlap multiple
assert merge_intervals([[1,10],[2,3],[4,5],[6,7]]) == [[1,10]]
# Single interval
assert merge_intervals([[0,0]]) == [[0,0]]
# Ensure input not modified
orig = [[1,3],[2,6]]
copy = [list(p) for p in orig]
merge_intervals(orig)
assert orig == copy, "Input modified"
# ValueError
try:
    merge_intervals([[3,1]])
    assert False, "Expected ValueError"
except ValueError:
    pass
